verdict.rationale: The probe shows INPI runs an IP open-data portal (data.inpi.fr) that serves data to account-holders via a token, which hints at machine-accessible public data rather than scraping. However, the keyless request was refused with a 403, and the docs only mention searchable databases and individual RNE attestations, not bulk extracts. Missing for 10: documented bulk dataset or registry-extract downloads (formats, update cadence, coverage), keyless or low-friction access, and independent or hands-on confirmation that bulk files are actually retrievable.
